reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Definitions of innovation education campus and fund
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 including subdivisions (1) and (2), paragraphs (a) through (d), history note (L. 2013 S.B. 381), and Revisor footnote (*'Linn State Technical College' in original rolls; renamed effective 7-01-14). Defines 'innovation education campus' partnership components and the dedicated fund.

headings.title: Creation, custody, investment, and nonreversion of fund
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Creates the Innovation Education Campus Fund administered by the commissioner of higher education, designates the state treasurer as custodian under sections 30.170 and 30.180, restricts use to administration upon appropriation, exempts balances from section 33.080 reversion, and credits interest to the fund.

headings.title: General assembly appropriations for campus instruction
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Authorizes ('may appropriate') general assembly appropriations to the fund to support instruction programs at innovation education campuses.

headings.title: Program criteria for participating institutions to receive funding
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 including subdivisions (1) through (5) and notes. Lists five required criteria—degree-cost reduction, time-to-degree reduction, applied/industry-informed learning, career access with partner Missouri businesses, and ongoing industry stakeholder engagement.

headings.title: Deemed eligibility of existing Missouri innovation campus
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and notes. Deems the existing Missouri innovation campus (University of Central Missouri, specified charter-county school district and community college, and private enterprises) to have satisfied subsection 4 criteria and to be eligible for funding.

headings.title: Five-year coordinating board compliance review and partner input
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and notes. Distinguished from subsection 7 by requiring five-year CBHE compliance reviews (including the subsection 5 campus) with partner consultation and optional business/industry feedback.

headings.title: Annual compliance verification and fund disbursement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 and notes. Distinguished from subsection 6 by requiring each innovation campus to verify subsection 4 compliance annually to CBHE as a condition for fund disbursement.

headings.title: Partner allocations, separate appropriation status, and private funds
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 and notes. Directs partner allocations through the appropriations process, excludes fund appropriations from institutional/district annual appropriations, and prohibits placing private funds into the state fund. Separate review: Revised title to include the exclusion of fund moneys from regular institutional and school district annual appropriations alongside partner allocations and private-fund exclusion.

headings.title: Coordinating board rulemaking and chapter 536 nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 9 and notes. Directs CBHE rulemaking (retaining archived 'supercede' spelling without modifying source), requires chapter 536 and section 536.028 compliance, and voids rulemaking authority and post-August 28, 2013 rules if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

headings.title: Annual state aid for readers for eligible blind students
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/source notes (L. 1963 p. 200 § 13-16 through A.L. 1994 S.B. 619). Provides $500 annually upon application to rehabilitation services for the blind for eligible blind Missouri citizens in local/special school districts or Missouri degree-granting institutions, excluding schools established for regular instruction of the blind.

headings.title: Ineligibility under other reader programs and matching-fund exception
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Bars direct aid to blind persons eligible under other state or federal reader programs, while permitting up to $500 annually in required matching funds for those programs. Separate review: Revised title to clarify that eligible individuals (rather than programs) are excluded from direct aid while permitting up to $500 in required matching funds.

headings.title: District programs for juveniles in county or court facilities

Requires school districts (except districts inside a special school district) and special school districts containing county- or court-operated juvenile facilities to educate school-age juveniles who have not graduated twelfth grade.

headings.title: State aid allocation and cap on district expenditures
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Entitles serving districts to section 163.031 aid for nonhandicapped children and statutory aid for handicapped/severely handicapped children, and caps required district spending at funds received under sections 178.295 to 178.298.

headings.title: Domiciliary district cost sharing, contracting, and plan approval

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Requires direct payment by domiciliary districts to serving districts and authorizes written vouchers and DESE payment enforcement under section 162.970.

headings.title: Petition and election to organize as community college district
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Deems continuously operated pre-October 13, 1961 school-district community colleges to meet organization standards and authorizes petitioning under section 178.800 for a coterminous sections 178.770 to 178.890 district election.

headings.title: School district property-tax reduction upon voter approval
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Reduces the school district property-tax levy by the prior community-college rate upon voter approval and subjects future increases to Article X, Section 11(c) of the Missouri Constitution.

headings.title: Definitions for homemaker vocational fee waiver program

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and notes. Directs appropriation-limited annual grants divided between area vocational-technical schools and community colleges under the state plan for federal vocational education funds.

headings.title: Regionally distributed DESE agricultural education staff
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and notes. Requires DESE to maintain an adequate number of regionally distributed, certified full-time agricultural education employees supporting K-12 programming and districts.

headings.title: Voluntary participation for public elementary schools
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and notes. Clarifies that section 178.530 does not require public elementary schools to participate in the elementary agricultural education program.

headings.title: Exemption from section 160.514 requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and notes. Exempts section 178.530 from the requirements of section 160.514.

headings.title: Short title and Career and Technical Education Advisory Council
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/source notes (L. 1963 p. 200 § 13-55 through A.L. 2026 S.B. 890). Designates the 'Career and Technical Education Student Protection Act' and establishes the advisory council within DESE.

headings.title: Council membership, Missouri residency, and commissioner appointees
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including subdivisions (1) through (9) and paragraphs (a) through (g), and notes. headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 including subdivisions (1) through (5) and notes. Sets five-year terms for commissioner-appointed members, with initial one- to five-year staggered terms across eleven seats.

headings.title: Bipartisan general assembly members and tenure
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and notes. Provides four legislative members (two senators appointed by president pro tempore, two representatives by speaker, max one per party per chamber) serving until resignation, leaving office, or replacement.

headings.title: Nonvoting ex officio advisory council members
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 including subdivisions (1) through (3) and notes. Adds three nonvoting ex officio members: DESE guidance/counseling director, office of workforce development director, and a CBHE-selected member.

headings.title: Staff assistance from DESE college and career readiness office
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and notes. Directs the DESE assistant commissioner for the office of college and career readiness to provide council staff assistance.

headings.title: Meetings, officers, procedural rules, and expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 and notes. Requires at least four annual meetings, permits meeting/officer rules, directs officer elections, and provides uncompensated service with optional actual-expense reimbursement. headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 and notes. headings.title: Annual written report on career and technical education budget
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 9 and notes. Distinguished from subsection 10 by requiring an annual written report to the state board and commissioner on the state CTE budget.

headings.title: Annual recommendations on student organization fund oversight
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 10 and notes. Distinguished from subsection 9 by requiring annual written recommendations on oversight and fund-handling procedures for student CTE organizations.

headings.title: Advisory council planning, gap analysis, recommendations, and bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 11 including subdivisions (1) through (6) and notes. headings.title: DESE duty to provide documentation and information
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 12 and notes. Requires DESE to provide documentation and information needed for the advisory council to be effective.

headings.title: Definition of advisory council

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Requires each grant-receiving school, college, or district to maintain a broad-based local advisory committee to plan graduate transitions to four-year colleges or high-wage jobs.

headings.title: Annual statewide and substate listing of demand occupations

headings.title: Minimum seventy-five percent allocation for demand occupations
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and notes. Requires at least seventy-five percent of fiscal-year grant moneys to support new programs, curriculum enhancement, or equipment addressing subsection 3 demand occupations.

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and notes. Requires board dissolution of a capital improvement subdistrict if voters do not approve a tax within five years of establishment.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived text of subsections 1 to 5 including the YES/NO ballot table in subsection 3, history note (L. 2002 H.B. 2022 merged with S.B. 947), and verified all fingerprints. Preserved the notable statutory contrast between tax-rate wording in subsections 2 and 4 (within 178.770–178.891 limits) and borrowing/bond ballot language in subsection 3 without altering source, and confirmed mandatory dissolution if no tax is voter-approved within five years. Retained all five drafted titles.

headings.title: Annexation of adjoining school districts and special district formation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/source notes (L. 1963 p. 200 § 13-89, A.L. 1978 H.B. 971, A.L. 1998 S.B. 553). Covers section 162.441 annexation of an entire adjoining school district to an existing community college district or pre-October 13, 1961 section 178.370 college district, forming a special district with sixty-day trustee election.

headings.title: Annexation of qualifying noncontiguous school districts
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including subdivisions (1) and (2) with continuation text, and notes. Permits section 162.441 annexation without contiguity where the receiving community college district lies in an adjacent county or a county adjacent to one lacking a public four-year open-enrollment institution.

headings.title: Hearing and discretionary state-aid withholding for petition refusal
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Authorizes petitioning the state board of education for a hearing if a receiving board rejects annexation, and permits discretionary withholding of section 163.191 state aid upon finding refusal without good cause. Separate review: Revised title to make discretionary ("in its discretion may withhold") state-aid withholding explicit.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived text of subsections 1 to 3 (including subdivisions 2(1) and 2(2) with continuation text), history and source notes (L. 1963 through A.L. 1998 S.B. 553; L. 1961 p. 357 § 15), and verified all fingerprints. Preserved archived "state board of education" wording in subsections 1 and 3, verified section 162.441 adjoining and qualifying noncontiguous annexation rules and special-district formation for pre-October 13, 1961 section 178.370 colleges, and checked discretionary section 163.191 state-aid withholding after hearing. Revised subsection 3 title to make discretionary withholding explicit; retained subsections 1 and 2.

headings.title: Controlled work environment and personal development goal
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1965 p. 309 § 2). Directs sheltered workshops to provide a controlled work environment and program helping enrolled handicapped persons develop capacity, performance, and relationships.

headings.title: Diverse work experience matching enrollee needs
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Directs sheltered workshops, so far as possible, to provide diverse work experience accommodating each enrolled handicapped person's needs.

headings.title: Coordination and use of community agency services
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Requires sheltered workshops to coordinate and integrate services with community agencies and use available agency services whenever practicable.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived text of subsections 1 to 3, history note (L. 1965 p. 309 § 2), and verified all source and body fingerprints. Confirmed controlled work environment and development purpose, "so far as possible" diverse work experience qualification, and "whenever practicable" community-agency coordination and service use. Retained all three drafted titles.

headings.title: Written request for sheltered workshop certificate of approval
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1965 p. 309 § 3). Directs groups seeking to establish a state-aid-eligible sheltered workshop to submit a written certificate-of-approval request on department forms.

headings.title: Sixty-day suitability hearing by department
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Requires the department to hold a suitability hearing within sixty days of receiving the certificate request.

headings.title: Approval notice and nonprofit filing conditions for certificate
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Directs notice of approval after favorable hearing, with issuance conditioned on filing nonprofit incorporation papers, charter, and nonconflicting bylaws.

headings.title: Refusal of certificate and revocation after notice and hearing
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Permits refusing issuance upon unfavorable finding and revoking a certificate (worded 'certificate of authority' in archived text) after notice and hearing for lack of need or rule violation. Separate review: Revised title to clarify that "after notice and hearing" applies to revocation rather than initial refusal.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived text of subsections 1 to 4, history note (L. 1965 p. 309 § 3), and verified all source and body fingerprints. Confirmed written certificate-of-approval request, sixty-day suitability hearing, nonprofit incorporation/charter/bylaws filing conditions, and subsection 4 refusal vs. post-notice-and-hearing revocation (retaining archived "certificate of authority" wording shift in subsection 4). Revised subsection 4 title so "after notice and hearing" clearly modifies revocation; retained subsections 1 to 3.

headings.title: Monthly state payments, twenty-one-dollar minimum, and proration
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 2018 H.B. 1415 merged with S.B. 743, A.L. 2019 S.B. 275). Directs DESE monthly payments from appropriated funds starting July 1, 2018, with a $21 minimum per six-hour or longer day up to a thirty-eight-hour week and percentage proration for shorter hours. Separate review: Revised "floor" to "minimum" for closer alignment with statutory "at least twenty-one dollars" wording.

headings.title: Proportional monthly payment calculation formula
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including subdivisions (1) and (2) and notes. Calculates each workshop's monthly payment by dividing the fiscal-year appropriation by twelve and allocating proportionally by preceding-month submitted hours.

headings.title: Prima facie payment proof and on-site signed hours record
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Directs accepting designated paper or electronic proof of payment due and requires maintaining a signed president/secretary/manager monthly hours statement at the workshop.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived text of subsections 1 to 3 (including subdivisions 2(1) and 2(2)), history note (L. 2018 H.B. 1415 merged with S.B. 743; A.L. 2019 S.B. 275), and verified all fingerprints. Confirmed appropriation-funded monthly payments from July 1, 2018, $21 minimum per six-hour-or-longer day up to 38 hours/week with percentage proration, one-twelfth proportional allocation formula by submitted preceding-month hours, and paper/electronic prima facie proof plus on-site signed hours statement. Revised subsection 1 title from "floor" to "minimum"; retained subsections 2 and 3.

headings.title: Definitions of certificate and commensurate wage
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 including subdivisions (1) and (2) and history note (L. 2021 H.B. 432). Defines 'certificate' for special-wage authorization and 'commensurate wage' tied to productivity relative to experienced nondisabled workers.

headings.title: Special wage certificates below sections 290.500 to 290.530 rates
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including subdivisions (1) through (3) and notes. Directs providing special certificates for disabled sheltered-workshop workers (preserving archived 'to contrary' phrasing) at productivity-related commensurate wages below sections 290.500 to 290.530 rates where needed to prevent employment curtailment.

headings.title: Required written assurances for wage reviews and annual adjustments
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 including subdivisions (1) and (2) and notes. Bars issuing subsection 2 certificates without written assurances of at least semiannual hourly-wage reviews and at least annual adjustments for locality prevailing wages.

headings.title: Two-year restriction on reducing certified hourly wage rates
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and notes. Prohibits reducing a disabled worker's certificate-prescribed hourly wage rate for two years without prior department authorization.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived text of subsections 1 to 4 (including subdivisions 1(1)–(2), 2(1)–(3), and 3(1)–(2)), history note (L. 2021 H.B. 432), and verified all fingerprints. Confirmed certificate and commensurate-wage definitions, special certificates below sections 290.500 to 290.530 rates (noting archived "to contrary" wording), written assurances for semiannual hourly reviews and annual locality prevailing-wage adjustments, and two-year reduction bar ("from such date" without a separately named antecedent date) subject to prior department authorization. Retained all four drafted titles.
